transcript: "Last summer Lina went to Cornwall with her family. They stayed in a small hotel near the harbour. The sea was cold but the sun was warm. They saw seals from the cliffs. They ate fish and chips on the beach."

transcript: "Sam stayed at home last summer. He cleaned his desk, read three books, learned how to bake bread, and started a small notebook of recipes. He didn't travel, but he says it was the calmest summer of his life."
